Name: Elihu
Role: Friend of Job; Son of Barachel
Summary: Elihu, son of Barachel the Buzite, was the younger friend who spoke last in the book of Job, answering both Job and his three friends.
KeyStory: After Job's three friends fell silent, Elihu argued that God speaks through suffering to teach and restore, and that Job's demand to argue his case missed God's majesty — preparing the way for God's own answer from the whirlwind.
LifeLesson: Elihu reminds us that youth is no bar to truth, and that suffering may be God's instruction rather than His punishment.
